text: Jul 2006: district 5, airport with a power line through it (84-89,114-117), seaport + east job strip, homes beside it (loans #5-7). Audit airport check fixed to count lines inside the zone.
Feb 2007: the airport developed within ~7 months (16 tiles) with the power line through it - the first working airport since attempt 1. Shop demand jumped to +1,936.
Feb 2008: stadium, coal plant, seaport 2, west factory block, river crossing + west district 1 (loans #8-11). Fixed the recurring stray calibration road on the x37 line by hand.
Feb 2010: lake pumps, west district 2, factory strip, west shops (loan #12); power link to the strip fixed by hand (two park tiles sat on its line row).
Nov 2014: 45,640 people, all demand positive, loan #16 refused by the guard, power 11% spare: taxes 7 -> homes 10 / shops 9 / factories 9 for income (controller floor 8).
Feb 2015: north-west district + coal plant, south-west district 2 (loans #16-17), NW shop pipe; SE coal plant waits for cash.
Feb 2017: SE coal plant, road links to the west and east map edges, south-west district 3 with west-shore pumps (loans #18-19).

Sep-Nov 2017: a fire (likely another plane crash near the south airport) burned ~3,900 tiles of the west bank and south (59,820 -> 30,380). Research (ludo.guide): each fire station gives one firefighter dispatch (max 33) - I only ever placed 2-3 of ~20 available; rubble and trees burn, so firebreaks must clear rubble and roads too. New rule: at the first flames, pause and surround the fire with every dispatch.
Nov 2017: loan #25 taken with LOAN_OK=1 although the guard projected -$81k (limit -$80k): ~15 districts burned by the fire still have no power and pay no tax until the rebuild's last lines go in.

CONTROL: autocal test roads kept appearing on power lines after builds and cutting them (5 more after the 2017 rebuild). build.py now ends every build with a sweep: lone new road tiles not in the plan are bulldozed and any line under them re-placed (caught one at once).
Nov 2022: 69,410 people, homes demand +750, cash -$28.8k falling ~$6k/yr: home tax 8 -> 11.
Jun 2023: water 9% spare with cash -$33.6k - pond pumps need a loan; guard overridden (LOAN_OK=1) because a water shortage would stall the whole city.
